question: What expiation procedure is prescribed for those constantly attached to the linga-body?
premises: An expiation procedure is to be declared.
Its recipients are those attached to the linga-body.
inference: A constant expiation procedure is established for those attached to the linga-body.
uncertainties: The exact sense of liṅgāṅgasaṅginām as bodily attachment or ritual association is context-dependent.
plain_english: I will declare the expiation procedure that always applies to those attached to the linga-body.
